stories.title: Who was the Butte County shooter?
stories.snippet:
A man who shot and injured two kindergarteners at a private religious 
school in Butte County on Wednesday was identified by law enforcement as 
56-year-old Glenn Litton. Butte County Sheriff Kory Honea said Litton 
suffered from mental illness and had a lengthy — though not violent — 
criminal record.
